name: it-pmo-kanban-v2
description: IT PMO Kanban v2 — vanilla HTML/CSS/JS delivery board demo with dark mode and RAG health

paragraphs: An internal demo and training Kanban board for the IT Project Management Office of a fictitious bank. It tracks IT delivery work across Backlog, In Progress, Blocked and Done, and fits in one index.html file with no dependencies. It uses no real bank's logo, trademarks or styling.
This is the v2 redesign. The original v1 is still at it-pmo-kanban (live).
features: Four columns (Backlog, In Progress, Blocked, Done) with count badges, plus a summary of totals and overdue tasks.
Move cards by native drag and drop or with each card's keyboard-friendly Move ▸ menu.
Filter by project, assignee and priority. The column badges show shown / total while a filter is on.
Overdue tasks (due date before today and not Done) are flagged on the card.
Add Task modal with inline validation and length limits. New cards get IDs like UOB-ITPM-0009.
